text: Every purchase over $2,500 needs an approved purchase order raised before the order is placed.
A person may not approve a request they raised themselves.
Any amount over $10,000 needs approval from a director.
Orders must not be split to stay under an approval limit.
Only current, authorised approvers may approve.
Payments may only go to active vendors.
Each supplier has one vendor record, identified by its tax ID.
No payment may be released to a changed bank account until verification is recorded.
A tax form must be on file before the first payment to a vendor.
The amount paid must match the approved invoice amount.
A single invoice may be paid once only.
Every payment must reference an approved invoice dated on or before the payment date.
Payments are released on working days only.
Meals are limited to $75.00 per person.
A receipt is required for any claim over $25.00.
Personal items are not reimbursable.
Weekend expenses need a business reason.
Each receipt may be claimed once only.
Charges not listed in the contract price schedule may not be billed.
Rates billed must match the contract rate card.
Services may only be billed within the contract term.
Auto-renewing contracts need a cancellation decision before the notice date.
